name: Tool — Foundry IQ (1P MCP)
summary: Microsoft 1P MCP server: Foundry IQ. Attached via MCPTool with AgenticIdentity auth.
description: Foundry IQ is a first-party MCP server that exposes Microsoft Foundry knowledge, docs, samples, and model catalog content to a Prompt Agent. The host agent uses `{connection}/{deployment}` for its orchestrator model while the MCP tool supplies grounded Foundry context.
notes:
Verified end-to-end: a BYOM-routed Prompt Agent attached to the Foundry IQ MCP server (`AgenticIdentity` auth) returns a Foundry-grounded response. See `test.py`.

> Live probe on 2026-07-16 against `ai-foundry-3swd46vd3j22a` with `FOUNDRY_IQ_MCP_URL` configured: `make_mcp_tool(url=FOUNDRY_IQ_MCP_URL, label='foundry_iq', auth='AgenticIdentity')` on a `PromptAgentDefinition(model='{apim-conn}/gpt-4o-mini')`; `invoke_agent(aoai, agent, 'Ask Foundry IQ for one fact...')` returned non-empty `output_text`.

Foundry IQ is on the official BYOM-supported tools list: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway#supported-configurations ('1P MCP servers: Foundry IQ, SharePoint Grounding, Fabric Data Agent').
